native_fallback.execution: actual native function and jump tables; C43230 actor-job ABI stub only

equipment_path.scope: Solo original-resource acquisition. The native dual carrier follows a separate generic pair path.
equipment_path.original_view_suffix_lookup_semantics: ItemInfoGetter(itemID), read field +0x40, Lua ReqWeaponNameByClassNum(view). This is not an automatic decimal item-ID filename.
equipment_path.mace_first_candidate_scope: For observed item1504/view8 and female Assassin family. If present, the original-view ACT check succeeds before the 8-to-2 solo fallback. The matching SPR must also be provided; this does not change the separate native dual carrier.

limits: Exact visible RGBA correspondence proves only the registered reference image transform.
It does not prove a mace grip shares the same point/axis or animation timing as that reference.
Source requirements are the finite accepted female Assassin rig, not every native action/frame.
No body-hand landmarks are inferred. No client resource or executable is modified.
